scenes.title: The Alley
scenes.mood: Heavy rain, wet pavement, sodium light, black-blue shadows.
beats: Three minutes past the hour. Heavy rain over the docks.
Captain Gabardina wakes on wet pavement.
Something pale rests on his chest.
A severed hand. Not his own.
The rain taps the fingers like it expects an answer.

scenes.title: The Blood Lab
scenes.mood: Sub-level lavatory, fluorescent red-white light, alarm flicker, copper and solvent.
beats: The accountant arrives twenty minutes late.
The keycard reader stutters and lets her through.
The smell hits before the sight.
A monitor draws someone's memory in red.

scenes.title: The Zoo
scenes.mood: False warm morning, families, balloons, screaming animals, sign bleeding.
beats: For the first time since the city stopped sleeping: no rain.
A queue of families. Coffee steam. Balloons.
Gabardina notices the birds have stopped.
Inside the zoo, every animal screams at once.
A child points and says: They're remembering.
